name: Sentinel Lynx
function: Review Flock-family evidence, save reception GPS, and document consented field observations.
description: A watchful circuit creature. A Flock candidate is a clue, never a confirmed camera.

name: Echo Bat
function: Inspect Raven-name/custom BLE service evidence and track relative RSSI.
description: Listens for broadcast identifiers. Shared standard BLE services do not establish Raven identity.

name: Aperture Raptor
function: Review Falcon/LPR name hints, annotate coordinates and photographs.
description: A golden lens guardian. Model/name evidence remains unverified.

name: Lens Beetle
function: Review other camera-vendor hints and attach local field notes.
description: A tiny armored optic. RF cannot reveal every wired, cellular, or silent camera.

name: Neon Wisp
function: Observe access-point metadata and relative signal strength; refresh only with approved standard scans.
description: A luminous network wanderer. Sightings never require association or password attacks.

name: Cipher Moth
function: Observe BLE advertisements. Owned/volunteer GATT inventory remains separately consent-gated in the field desk.
description: A winged messenger of advertised services and manufacturer hints.

name: Static Sprite
function: Keep uncertain sightings available for later manual annotation.
description: An unresolved signal. Unknown evidence is never upgraded into a confident identity.
